t: G45 Field Fabrication Engine: Plasma Frequency Desk — Simple
name: G45 Field Fabrication Engine: Plasma Frequency Desk — Simple
title: G45 Field Fabrication Engine: Plasma Frequency Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Plasmas oscillate at ω_p = √(ne²/ε₀m): the desk computes the plasma frequency for any electron density. The frequency decides what the plasma reflects, absorbs, and conducts — it is the plasma's name tag.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Plasma frequency at n=1e16 m⁻³ = 897866 kHz. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Perpetual Field Fabrication Engine Space.0 (G45) – Quantifying the Plasma-Field Construction Constant (PFC_Const)
real_world_basis: Plasma frequency math is the real basis of plasma physics.
signature_version: Signature version: the PFC_Const frequency desk — the chapter's Plasma-Field Construction Constant as the control target, with the perpetual framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: measure the density independently — the frequency follows it.
math_note: Plasma frequency at n=1e16 m⁻³: 897866 kHz [verified]; Plasma frequency at n=1e12 m⁻³: 8978.7 kHz [verified]

math_check.label: Plasma frequency at n=1e16 m⁻³
